scope: Native BF16 FSDP2, frozen four math prefixes, one MDPO-trained 144-step checkpoint plus identical restored Adam. Each method changes only output numerical computations. This is not a replay of the original E45/E46/E47 late states. BPO and kappa=0.5 also start from the kappa=0 MDPO checkpoint.
source_note: During these runs concurrent work merged FP16/AMP support into main. The exercised BF16 target and Triton row functions were unchanged; the previous PrecomputedKL audit snapshot also differs by a temporary-output deletion. No BPO/endpoint/target production numerical fix is introduced by this audit.

mdpo-k0.scope:
Four-rank real-teacher MDPO diagnostic on four fixed math continuations.

Requires four GPUs and saved fixed-prefix records. Packed SDPA comparisons are
valid here only because each rank/micro-batch contains exactly one sequence.
Use on an allocated GPU pool; the memory cap is not a scheduler reservation.

Uses the production FSDP2 engine, global token normalization, anchor scope and
AdamW. This creates a local low-KL state, not a reconstruction of the original
on-policy E45/E47 history. Pre/post evaluation uses FP64 row arithmetic.
